definitions: To enjoy the benefits of two desirable but mutually exclusive things.
To want more than one can reasonably have.
To have something good and still be able to use or enjoy it.
examples: She wants to work full-time and travel the world, but you can't have your cake and eat it too.
He tried to have his cake and eat it too by spending all his money and still expecting to have savings.
You want a high-paying job with no responsibilities? You can't have your cake and eat it too.
lemma: to have your cake and eat it too
synonyms: to want the best of both worlds
source: to have your cake and eat it too
